

Things I do to make it works:

1. Freeswitch home, add below 2 line in the docker-compose.yml  
   1. “5066:5066/tcp”  
   2. “7443:7443/tcp”

   

![][image1]

2. Add this 2 port in AWS to allow traffic go through it in secure group inbound rules

![][image2]

Verify if your setting is good, run below:

1. docker exec teleiq-freeswitch sh \-c 'grep \-n "ws-binding\\|wss-binding" /etc/freeswitch/sip\_profiles/internal.xml'  
     
   ![][image3]  
 


2. docker exec teleiq-freeswitch fs\_cli \-x "sofia status profile internal"

   

   ![][image4]

 


[http://localhost:5173/](http://localhost:5173/)![][image5]

Click Connect & Register, it will show  
![][image6]

Click Start Voice, then start call

I created a file inside switch so when people call 9999, it will behave (answer, sleep, park)

/etc/freeswitch/dialplan/default/00\_webrtc\_test.xml  
\<include\>  
  \<extension name="webrtc\_test\_9999"\>  
    \<condition field="destination\_number" expression="^9999$"\>  
      \<action application="answer"/\>  
      \<action application="sleep" data="500"/\>  
      \<action application="park"/\>  
    \</condition\>  
  \</extension\>  
\</include\>

I create test user 1001 and it password in this file:  
/etc/freeswitch/directory/default/1001.xml  
\<include\>  
  \<user id="1001"\>  
    \<params\>  
      \<param name="password" value="spass95321"/\>  
      \<param name="vm-password" value="1001"/\>  
    \</params\>  
    \<variables\>  
      \<variable name="toll\_allow" value="domestic,international,local"/\>  
      \<variable name="accountcode" value="1001"/\>  
      \<variable name="user\_context" value="default"/\>  
      \<variable name="effective\_caller\_id\_name" value="Extension 1001"/\>  
      \<variable name="effective\_caller\_id\_number" value="1001"/\>  
      \<variable name="outbound\_caller\_id\_name" value="$${outbound\_caller\_name}"/\>  
      \<variable name="outbound\_caller\_id\_number" value="$${outbound\_caller\_id}"/\>  
      \<variable name="callgroup" value="techsupport"/\>  
    \</variables\>  
  \</user\>  
\</include\>
